title: Extensions: scoring surveys without a QSF
text: package three layers: Layer 1 reads Qualtrics survey produces standardised question catalogue: tibble one row per live question, flow order, structural fields scorer needs. intermediate representation. Layer 2 resolves survey’s routing logic (branches, block randomisers, early exits) display logic (conditional questions) set feasible respondent paths. layer currently reads QSF’s SurveyFlow element directly , therefore, partially platform-specific.
